title: What Happens When Half Your Raw Study Vanishes Within One Hour?

acts.name: 1885 Berlin One-Man Metronome & 2,300 Nonsense-Syllable Protocol
sentences: You think late cramming locks facts into memory!
Yet raw study drops off a steep cliff!
this medical mystery started with Hermann Ebbinghaus's Forgetting Curve.

acts.name: The First-Hour Waterfall (58% at 20m -> 44% at 1h -> 21% at 31d)
sentences: How fast did raw unlinked memory disappear?
Within twenty minutes, retention fell to fifty-eight percent, like a leaky barrel.
After one hour, forty-four percent remained, losing over half.
By thirty-one days, twenty-one percent clung on, like a clay block.
Forgetting struck fastest right at the start, then slowed.
Rote lists plunged fast, while poetry held ten times easier.
Meaning hooked into the hippocampus, your memory maker, right away.
Meaningful lines gripped ten times stronger, like a hook-and-loop strap.
Cramming dry unlinked trivia overnight was a total nightmare.

acts.name: Hidden Relearning Savings Score & The 24-Hour Overnight Sleep Plateau
sentences: Does drawing a blank mean a memory vanished?

acts.name: Flattening Your Own Forgetting Curve at +1h, +1d, and +3d
sentences: How can you beat the early cliff today?
